§6Redstone Relay§f

§aSend redstone signals through duct networks for remote automation and control!§f

§bRedstone Relays§f attach to any duct type, carrying redstone signals alongside whatever the duct is transporting.

§6Crafting§f:
§e1× Redstone§f + §e1× Nether Quartz§f + §e2× Signalum Nugget§f + §e2× Lead Ingot§f → §e1× Redstone Relay§f.

§6Transfer Modes§f:
§b• Redstone Input§f: reads signal from adjacent block, sends through ducts.
§b• Redstone Output§f: receives from ducts, outputs to adjacent block.
§b• Comparator Input§f: measures like a comparator, transmits strength.

§6Signal Modes§f: Scaled, Inverted Scaled, Threshold, Inverted Threshold.

§e16 color-coded channels§f, relays only talk on the same channel, so you can run §e16 independent signals§f through one duct network without interference.
